scope: Development-only fixed-protein actual-set comparison under common protein-plus-fixed-TAA input semantics; no native-CDS or native-derived normalization is supplied to the search. Terminal-set quality only, not time-matched, functional, untouched, or external-SOTA evidence.
observed: RK38 verified 18x7 external actual sets and 846 raw run/method cells, but native-source calibration and unequal output cardinality blocked a fair CodonFlow-search versus LinearDesign comparison.
hypothesis: Protein-only hill-climbing improves both normalized hypervolume and pairwise NED over LinearDesign-11 when each record is evaluated at exactly the LinearDesign actual unique-sequence count.
population: 18 unique development records only; no untouched24, functional untouched, MAGE test, Ribo test, or functional assay labels

input_semantics.algorithm_input: protein sequence plus fixed terminal TAA; simple-search x0 is random synonymous codons constructed from a protein-only template
input_semantics.external_primary_methods_verified_termin: TAA for every LinearDesign-11 and EnsembleDesign-11 actual output
input_semantics.evaluation_reference: Frozen native-source calibration is loaded only after search and applied identically to simple-search and external actual sets for evaluation only

budget_rule: Budget 1 is the protein-only random synonymous initial state. Each previously unscored legal sequence consumes exactly one unique-scorer budget. Eleven contiguous real points are generated per run; no dense external trajectory is inferred.
matched_actual_set_rule: For each record, let k be the frozen number of unique LinearDesign-11 actual DNA sequences (1<=k<=11). Evaluate the first k real unique-search outputs against all k LinearDesign-11 outputs. Hypervolume and NED are order-invariant at the matched terminal sets; no best-k or post-hoc subset selection is allowed.
effect_direction: protein-only simple-search minus LinearDesign-11; positive favors simple-search for both endpoints

statistics.unit: one record; arithmetic mean of its three seeds before paired inference
statistics.ci_method: two-sided percentile paired bootstrap of record-level mean effects
statistics.p_value: two-sided paired sign-flip with plus-one correction, capped at 1
statistics.multiplicity: Holm over the two preregistered primary endpoints only
statistics.success_rule: Both endpoints require 95% CI lower bound >0, Holm-adjusted p<0.05, and positive mean effects for every individual seed; otherwise the common-input task remains unresolved

sensitivity_rule: MH-annealing and uniform are diagnostic arms only. A positive sensitivity result cannot replace a failed hill-climbing primary gate or authorize external-SOTA claims.

execution.order: benchmark FASTA order, then seed ascending, then protocol method order
execution.resume: skip only byte-stable completed run JSON with matching protocol/input/initial-state identity and 11 points; never accept partial output

cost.report: per-run wall clock, objective-scoring time, residual generation/cache/proposal time, terminal requests and unique scorer calls

allowed_conclusion: A common-input, matched-cardinality terminal actual-set proxy comparison on 18 development records, with full search provenance and paired uncertainty.
forbidden_conclusion: No unified time-matched ranking, functional effectiveness, untouched generalization, full seven-method dense matrix, external SOTA authorization, CodonFlow-RK generator improvement, RK-G1 closure, or manuscript-submittable claim.
